title: A view that replaces another must hold the shared store's event subscription itself
rule: When a component takes the place of a route view (a v-if/v-else swap in App.vue, an overlay that unmounts the page) and reads a Pinia store that is fed by an event subscription (sources, scans, activation), the new component calls the store's load() in its own onMounted and stop() in its onBeforeUnmount. Do not rely on a subscription the store made before the swap: the outgoing view's onBeforeUnmount runs first and stops it. Test it with a Playwright step that opens the new component from the view that owned the subscription, triggers an event (add a folder, start a scan) and asserts the UI follows it, and check that the test fails without the load().
rationale: E55.4 (#643): the setup reopened from Settings showed no scan on a folder added there, because SettingsView's unmount stopped the sources store's subscription and the setup never resubscribed.
